summary.what_was_special: The focus couples a bounded minimum with maximal spatial range and closes with fineness plus interior knowledge. Context repeatedly converts that geometry into ethical accounting, organic emergence, embodied return, and trackable process without forcing those readings into one referent.
remaining_uncertainties: The feminine pronoun has no explicit focus-only antecedent, so deed, particle, seed, intention, and embodied self remain competing candidates.
Productive emergence and instantaneous retrieval both fit the bringing verb's branch inventory; context strengthens but does not disambiguate them.
Gestational and resurrection mechanisms may be complementary stages or independent analogies.
Marking, love-kernel, seed-covering, protective-weight, and fragment-allotment activations are branch-distant and require explicit exploratory qualification.
